group-roulette.title: Group Roulette
group-roulette.descriptionShort: Spin the same roulette wheel with a group.
group-roulette.description: Share a room URL and keep roulette items, spins, and results synced across everyone’s screen.
group-roulette.privacyNotice: Added item names, display names, and raw spin history are stored for administrator review for a limited period.
group-roulette.shareHelp: Send only this URL to participants. It does not include host-only management data.
group-roulette.idleActionHelp: Create a room first to get a share URL and item controls.
group-roulette.idleStageGuidance: Create a room to share the same roulette stage with everyone.
group-roulette.emptyStageGuidance: Add items to spin the roulette.
group-roulette.expiredStageGuidance: This room has expired. Create a new room to continue.
group-roulette.hostReadyGuidance: When the items are ready, the host can spin the roulette.
group-roulette.guestReadyGuidance: Review the items while waiting for the host to start.
group-roulette.spinningGuidance: The same roulette is spinning on everyone’s screen.
group-roulette.resultGuidance: The result is final. You can spin again with the same items.
group-roulette.guestCanAdd: You can add items. Waiting for the host to start.
group-roulette.optionEditorHelp: Added items appear on everyone’s screen.
group-roulette.joinBeforeAdding: Join the room to add items.
group-roulette.editingLocked: Items cannot be edited while spinning.
group-roulette.guestAddDisabledHelp: Participant item adding is currently off.

jukugo.title: Jukugo Puzzle
jukugo.description: This tool helps you solve a traditional Japanese puzzle, known as 'Wado Kaichin', where you guess the kanji in the center based on the surrounding four kanji.
jukugo.transitionNotice:
Welcome to the new 'Jukugo Puzzle' site.
If you came from the old site, please update your bookmark.
jukugo.arrowDescription: You can tap the arrows to reverse their direction.
